ValidationRule.description: Prevent changes on billing schedule if an opportunity if the opportunity stage is Closed or Won, unless user has System Admin profile.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( ISPICKVAL( Opportunity__r.StageName , "Won"), ISPICKVAL( Opportunity__r.StageName , "Closed"), ISPICKVAL( Opportunity__r.StageName , "Won & Closed") ),true)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Schedule cannot be changed if the Opportunity Stage is "Closed" or "Won" or "Won & Closed"
